title: Miniography archive manifest, version 1 (draft)
description: The UTF-8 miniography.json manifest inside a ZIP-based .miniography archive. Array order is reading order.

language.description: Language tag, such as en, de or en-GB. Full BCP 47 validity is an application check.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 form. Uppercase T and Z; fractional seconds are allowed.

modificationDates.description: Subsequent content-edit timestamps, oldest first; empty for an unedited entry. Ordering relative to createdAt requires application validation. These are not historical copies of the content.

placesLived.description: Optional free-form text. May include approximate dates; an empty string is also allowed.

topic.description: Optional snapshot of the named door or a journal topic.

question.description: The question as shown when answered, or null for a free-form journal entry.

text.description: The original answer or journal text, stored as plain text. Line breaks are preserved.

description.description: Context about who or what is pictured. Empty is allowed when no description has been written.

caption.description: Optional literal PDF label. Omission or an empty string means no printed caption. The description is not automatically printed.

filePath.description: Case-sensitive path relative to the ZIP root, using a portable filename. No absolute paths, subdirectories, traversal or URLs.

createdAt.description: When the photo entry was added to Miniography, not when the photograph was taken.

takenAt.description: Optional known capture date or UTC timestamp. Approximate dates belong in description; do not invent an exact date.
